Facts:
- The Commonwealth of Nations is a voluntary association of 52 sovereign states.
- In most member countries of the Commonwealth of Nations, use of the English language was inherited from British colonisation.
- English is spoken as a first or second language in most of the Commonwealth of Nations.
- In Cyprus and Malaysia, English does not have official status but is widely used as a lingua franca.
